messages:
Maria C.: hey all — noticed a 30s spike of 504s hitting /v1/generate at ~15:03 UTC, ~120 requests. little context: most from us-east region and includes a bunch of zero-token requests. can someone point me to the best dashboards and a few trace samples?
AJ: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/ux-error-metrics -> panel 'ingress 5xx by route' should show it. Datadog query I usually use: `sum:requests.errors{env:prod,route:/v1/generate}.rollup(sum,60)` then group by `http_status`.
Tim K.: also check the prefix-cache hit rate metric on the prefix-cache dashboard — prefix cache evictions can cause synchronous model loadbacks that show up as 504-ish timeouts. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/prefix-cache/prefix-cache-overview
Maria C.: thanks. any quick trace IDs people can paste here? I can use curl against trace API if I have one or grab from logs.
Observability-bot: deploy:frontend-service@prod completed 14:58 UTC (sha: a1b2c3). No related errors reported at that time.
Sam L.: I pulled a couple sample request_ids: rq_34k2, rq_34k7, rq_34kA — traces show long wait on upstream inference-pool queue (queue_ms ~1200) and then 504 from gateway.
Nisha: sounds like short overload. If this is a repeated pattern we should increase the alert debounce from 1m to 3m for the route 5xx alert. For a one-off spike I'd prefer quieting the alert for 10m while infra autoscaler warms.
AJ: config lives in ops/alerts/service-routes.yaml, rule `route-5xx-spike`. If you want a one-time quieting: `/quiet route-5xx-spike 10m` in PagerDuty.
Maria C.: pinging infra to check autoscaler logs + pool utilization. @Tim K. can you open a quick PR to add a short note in `runbooks/ingress-504.md` about checking `inference-pool.queue_ms` and prefix-cache? small doc change only.
Tim K.: on it — will do tiny doc PR and link the two grafana panels. should have it up in ~20m.
Sam L.: fyi I also saw a couple of client 4xxs correlated with the spike — possibly malformed requests that bypassed cache fast-lane. logs: `kinesis-logs/prod/2026-03-17` -> grep `rq_34k`.
Maria C.: perfect. once PR is up I can attach a few trace snippets to the ticket and we can decide if alert debounce change is needed. thanks :thumbsup:
Deploy-bot: rollback:frontend-service@prod triggered 15:10 UTC by autoscaler (reason: pool overcommit).
Nisha: if rollback is confirmed, let's mark incident as mitigated and follow up with a runbook edit to add autoscaler warm-up notes.
Maria C.: noted — filing follow-up ticket now and will include links to dashboards + trace IDs. thanks everyone for fast help.
